title: Claude Code Foundations
description: Learn core prompting, debugging, and automation workflows.

lessons.title: Structured Prompting
lessons.theory:
# Structured Prompting
Use role, context, constraints, output format.
lessons.example: Ask Claude for JSON output with validation constraints.
lessons.task: Write a prompt that requests a REST endpoint plan in JSON.

lessons.title: Debugging with AI
lessons.theory:
# Debugging
Provide stack trace + code + expected behavior.
lessons.example: Paste failing function and ask for root cause analysis.
lessons.task: Debug a function that returns duplicated records.
